newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian ship freed from sandbank off Albanian port.
newsitem.headline: Italian ship freed from sandbank off Albanian port.

text.p: Tug boats pulled an international security force's Italian flagship free from a sandbank off the rebel-held Albanian port of Vlore on Wednesday, an Italian military official and witnesses said.
They said the Vittorio Veneto, a cruiser and helicopter carrier, moved away from the coast and was surrounded by the four tugs which had rescued it.
The ship ran aground in stormy seas 500 metres (yards) offshore on Tuesday.

The Vittorio Veneto is the flagship of an Italian-led force trying to protect aid deliveries to Albania's poor after an armed insurrection prompted by failed investment schemes. About 160 Italian troops disembarked from Italian warships on Monday.
